claims.object_text: inhibition of PTP1B increases TRKB/BDNF signaling and restores cellular morphology in CDKL5-KO cells
claims.quote: Additionally, inhibition of PTP1B in differentiating SH-SY5Y cells increased TRKB/BDNF signaling. This effect was prominent in CDKL5-KO cells, which have increased PTP1B expression.
